structured_output.rationale: All five lines are always-therapy CPTs (97530, 97140, 97116) billed with only KX, no GP/GO/GN discipline modifier. CARC 4 clause two (required modifier missing) + N822 confirms a missing-modifier unprocessable rejection, not an adjudicated denial. Chart note documents PT treatment (therapeutic activities, manual therapy, gait training) under a PT plan of care, so GP is the correct modifier. Fix and resubmit as a new original claim; timely filing is not implicated.

root_cause.explanation: Lines 1-5 (97530-KX, 97140-KX, 97530-KX, 97140-KX, 97116-KX) denied CO-4/N822: required discipline modifier missing. Chart note shows PT services (therapeutic activities, manual therapy, gait training) with no GP appended on the 837P.

next_action.detail: Append GP (outpatient PT plan of care) to all five lines and submit as a NEW ORIGINAL claim (CLM05-3=1, no REF*F8) to Novitas Part B — CO-4/N822 was never adjudicated, so no reopening/appeal rights apply.

evidence.fact: All 5 lines carry CO-4 'procedure code is inconsistent with the modifier used' with remark N822 'missing procedure modifier(s)', $0 paid
Lines billed 97530-KX, 97140-KX, 97530-KX x2, 97140-KX x2, 97116-KX — only KX present, no GP/GO/GN
PT treatment note: therapeutic activities (97530), manual therapy (97140), gait training (97116), all physical therapy services

citations.rule: CO-4 + N822 on always-therapy CPTs 97110/97112/97140/97530 with no GP/GO/GN → missing_therapy_modifier; correct_and_resubmit as new original claim (CLM05-3=1), never appeal, never bill_patient
CARC 16/MA130 family unprocessable rejections require new original claim; CO-4 clause two operative here per therapy card
